versions.changelog:
**Summary: This update expands material support and unifies the workflow.**

- 支持 PPT、图片、PDF 三类配套材料自动识别与融合，材料来源更灵活
- skill 触发后先询问“有无配套材料”，不再仅限 PPT
- 融合演讲稿 PDF 支持图片/PDF/多图，材料多页自动对齐
- 移除用户文档文件（README.md, skill-card.md），简化到只剩配置说明
- 统一工作流和进度提示，“无材料”直接输出会议纪要 Word/txt
- 完善异常处理与类型自检，提升兼容性和易用性
Mermaid 流程图 C 节点合并为单一定义
v2.1.2: 优化搜索词覆盖、扩展触发词表、更新安装指引
v1.0.3: 新增 WorkBuddy 执行映射附录（Whisper 转写、LibreOffice 截图、ReportLab 出 PDF 的确定性命令）

- Expanded skill description and detailed documentation in SKILL.md, including step-by-step workflow and technical requirements.
- Added new usage scenarios, clearer process stages, and progress feedback messages.
- Included a capabilities mapping table for platform implementation reference.
- Enhanced trigger list with more variations for improved discoverability.
- Removed README.md and skill-card.md files.

ppt-speech-fusion version 0.1.1 changelog:

- Added detailed skill description, trigger phrases, and author information in SKILL.md.
- New feature: Instantly generate a professional PDF with synthesized speech narration and original slides, precisely aligned by page.
- Supports m4a/mp3/wav audio and pptx files.
- Automated transcription (Whisper), slide-audio matching, and quality checking streamline the process.
- Designed to save hours on manual meeting minutes and speech draft preparation.修正 Display Name 和 Slug

Initial release: Automatically generate professional speech reconstruction PDFs from meeting audio and PPT files.
- One-click process: Convert meeting recordings and PPTs into speech manuscripts—each PDF page displays a fluent speech narrative (top) and the original slide screenshot (bottom), aligned page-by-page.
- Audio transcription: Uses Whisper for full Chinese audio transcription, extracting key points and dialogue flow.
- PPT extraction: Pulls all text and full-slide images from PPTX files.
- Automated self-check: Ensures slide count matches, checks narrative fluency, and fixes alignment issues before output.
- Supports m4a/mp3/wav audio and pptx files. Provides stepwise feedback and robust error handling.
